# lab manifest

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

```text
Print the machine and software facts that belong with every test result, as key=value lines
(tuning/log tags each as env.<key> in MLflow). Same output as tuning/manifest.sh.
--host marvin runs it there over ssh (needs lab installed on marvin).
Good result: no "unknown" except where a part really is missing; llama_cpp_commit matches the image.
```

Usage:

```
lab manifest [flags]
```

Options:

```
      --host string   run on another machine over ssh (e.g. marvin)
      --json          one JSON object (for agents)
```
